newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Port conditions - Morocco, Azores - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions - Morocco, Azores - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: SAFI, Dec 25 - Delays for phosphate vessels one day.

PONTA DELGADA, Dec 26 - Stormy weather which hit St. Michael's Dec 24 and 25 now passed over but port considered inoperative. Tankers Seabird I and Starlight and refrigerated fishing vessel aground on marina breakwater. Sand dredger sunk near near marina. Some port machinery and equipment lost/damaged. Number of containers which were dragged from quays sunk inside harbour, with others afloat and strewn in port basin.
